This small plot is my perennial garden, mostly enset and maybe some coffee or fruit trees near the house. I have no schooling and little cash, so I cannot buy chemical fertilizer for these trees — I put the household manure and ash here because it is close to the house and the plants live many years. The rains in SNNP are usually enough, so I do not irrigate, and I do not spray chemicals. My daughters and I weed and tend it ourselves through the season; I do not hire anyone for such a small plot.
